snippet.title: Moldwasher Trailer | Six One Indie Showcase: September 2025
snippet.description:
Clean moldy messes as a brave food hero! Equip your high-pressure spray, choose the right nozzle, and clear away sticky messes in this cozy, arcade-style fridge-cleaning adventure.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3688130/Moldwasher/

Visit https://www.sixoneindie.com/showcase for more information.
